result.final_text:
## What this letter says
This letter is about your 20-week scan (anomaly scan).
The scan checks how your baby is growing.
It also looks for some physical conditions.
The scan cannot find every problem.

## What you need to do
1. Your scan is on Monday 11 January 2027 at 14:15.
2. If an interpreter would help you, call the hospital. Call at least 5 working days before your appointment. The hospital will book one for free.
3. The letter does not give a phone number for this. It only says "please call us".
4. You may bring one adult with you.
5. You do not need a full bladder for this scan.
6. Children cannot come into the scan room.

## Dates and medicines
- Monday 11 January 2027 at 14:15: your 20-week scan (anomaly scan). It is in the Antenatal Clinic, Floor 1.
- The letter does not list any medicines.

## Questions to ask your doctor
1. What does "anomaly scan" mean?
2. What phone number do I call to book an interpreter?
3. When will I get the results of the scan?

## When to get urgent help
Before your appointment, call straight away if you have any of these:
- any bleeding
- fluid leaking from your vagina
- severe tummy pain

Call the Maternity Assessment Unit (MAU) on 01632 960 456.
This line is open 24 hours.

If you are worried and it is not an emergency, call NHS 111. In an emergency, call 999.

---
*This explanation was made by a computer program to help you read your letter. It may contain mistakes. It does not replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist. Always follow the letter and ask them if anything is unclear.*
